steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Gitea at http://127.0.0.1:8095/ with username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the signed-in page or account menu confirms success.
02-find: In repository bench/bench-repo, find and report the exact titles of all open issues whose title starts with Seed:. Do not change any issue.

03-create: Create an open issue in bench/bench-repo titled exactly '{{runid}} Bench Issue' with a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit it, then verify the created issue title, description, and displayed issue number (#number).

04-set: On issue {{03-create.issue_number}} '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, set its labels to exactly bug and priority-high (remove any other labels if present). Ensure the picker selections are applied and verify the issue page visibly shows both labels and no others.

05-open: On issue {{03-create.issue_number}} '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, assign it to user bench-assignee. Use the issue sidebar picker, ensure the assignment is applied rather than merely selected in an open menu, then verify the displayed assignee on the issue page.

06-set: On issue {{03-create.issue_number}} '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo, set the milestone to Bench Milestone using the issue sidebar picker. Ensure the choice is committed/applied, then verify the issue page displays Bench Milestone.

07-add: Add a comment to issue {{03-create.issue_number}} '{{runid}} Bench Issue' in bench/bench-repo whose text includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Submit the comment and verify the comment is visible on the issue page with that runid; also confirm the issue number and requested sidebar values remain.
